dashboard.label: Server Health — sandbox
dashboard.description: Local Ubuntu telemetry sampled every 60 seconds. CPU and I/O use a 1-second sample; brief spikes between samples may be missed. Inventory covers the last 5 minutes; trends cover 1 hour. Refresh the dashboard to update.

search.query: index=host_metrics sourcetype=server:health:json | eval entity=coalesce(unit,mount,interface,device,tostring(pid),kind) | stats latest(*) as * latest(_time) as last_seen by kind entity
index=host_metrics sourcetype=server:health:json kind=system | timechart span=1m avg(cpu_pct) as CPU avg(memory_used_pct) as Memory avg(iowait_pct) as IOWait
| search kind=system | eval age=round(now()-last_seen) | stats max(age) as seconds
| search kind=system | stats latest(cpu_pct) as percent
| search kind=system | stats latest(memory_used_pct) as percent
| search kind=service_summary | stats latest(failed_count) as failed
| search kind=filesystem | eval available_GiB=round(available_bytes/1073741824,2) | table mount filesystem used_pct available_GiB inode_used_pct

| search kind=system | eval uptime_days=round(uptime_seconds/86400,2), swap_MiB=round(swap_used_bytes/1048576,1) | eval load1=round(load1,2), load5=round(load5,2), load15=round(load15,2) | table cpu_count load1 load5 load15 uptime_days swap_MiB
| search kind=network | table interface rx_bytes_sec tx_bytes_sec rx_errors tx_errors rx_drops tx_drops
| search kind=disk_io | table device read_bytes_sec write_bytes_sec busy_pct
| search kind=service active_state=failed | table unit active_state sub_state
| search kind=service unit IN ("Splunkd.service","docker.service","containerd.service","ssh.service","litellm.service","systemd-timesyncd.service") | table unit active_state sub_state
| search kind=process | eval rss_MiB=round(rss_bytes/1048576,1) | sort 10 -rss_MiB | table process pid rss_MiB
| search kind=collector_error | table component error last_seen
index=host_os | where tonumber(PRIORITY)<=4 | head 20 | table _time _SYSTEMD_UNIT PRIORITY MESSAGE
